question: In ΔABC, ∠B = 135°, AB = 5sqrt 2 cm and BC = 7 cm. The length of AC is:
solution:
**Given:**

∠B = 135°, AB = 5sqrt 2 cm and BC = 7 cm.

**Formula used:**

cosB = {(a² + c² - b²)over 2ac} Where, a, b, and c is the sides of the triangle

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83b2b2da7ab3c57ec64192b8476b2a38fa281971367fef03c80c4139c696ecd0.png] 

Let the length of the AC be L

According to the cosine rule

In ΔABC

⇒ cos135° = {(5sqrt{2})²} + {7²} - L²over 2 times 7 times {5sqrt{2}}

⇒ {-1oversqrt 2} ={(5sqrt{2})²} + {7²} - L²over 2 times 7 times {5sqrt{2}}

⇒ -70 = 50 + 49 - L²

⇒ L² = 169

⇒ L = 13, -13

**∴ The required result will be 13.**
